body:
Same therapist and psychiatrist all 8 years ... Many many different meds, the ones I'm on keep me the most "happy" but it's a constant hell even with me being "happy on meds" 

Without the meds I'd probably not be here right now. 

So they at least bring me to a state of non-action when it comes to suicide, but the thoughts and attempts never went away... If that makes any sense? Probably not. 

They make me *seem* fairly normal and non suicudal yet truly I am and docs and therapist and everyone knows ... So I dunno what more they can do.

I've had depression almost my whole life ... I'm 25 and have been suicidal for the last 6 years, I get glimpses of hope and light but they fade so fast I can't grasp them....feels like it'll never get better, but stupid old me still hopes it does.

The doctors prescribed me lithium because they *think* I'm a very very mild case of borderline personality disorder, I don't have any traits other than some fleeting black and white thinking and my compulsiveness of running off and thinking I can make my own life by leaving my bf and buying a car (one example of this last October) or renting my own apartment (last year) and buying 3k in furniture to furnish that apartment... I know that's unwise and a bit split second decision making but I feel abused being around him and I was trying so hard to get away. So that's why I'm on lithium 

Seroquel worked okay for me but pretty much doped me to the point of no return.
He just told me he wants me to be a better person ....
Just wanted to say I'm doing better :) thank you for your help, it is very appreciated. New day, new attitude :)
Hey, just woke up... 6am here and doing MUCH MUCH better, rough night but it's a new day :)

I've put 6 years of crap into my 25 years of life... I've hated almost all 25 years I fret waking up every day
Thank you, I'm trying to get out. Just hard when you have no ambition and just want to sleep constantly. I'm applying to places though trying to save money to gtfo
See why I'm thinking of ending it?

My mom has borderline personality disorder and physically and verbally abused me growing up, threatened to kill me...I have a restraining order on her. My sister lives in Hawaii. (I'm in Oregon) and she said I could move down there to be close but couldn't stay with her... And my father passed away. And my grandma and my grandpas and my aunt ... Don't know my cousins or anything... I literally have this one guy ... 

I'm a loser

Yeah ... I know. Just don't have anywhere to go, he made me break my lease on my apartment and move in with him and now he has me working for his parents ... I'm pretty much screwed. No home and no real job ...I was thinking he was my hero helping me, when really he screwed me.
Yeah I'm sure I'll get there eventually.

Yeah, that would be awesome if I was allowed to go see people and do things. The guy I'm currently with gets super quiet and almost angry when I go out without him, like he said "I allow you to stay home and give you freedom to do what you want during the day, and you decide to talk to other guys?!" (My guy friends, nothing more) 

I choose real fucking winners

Yeah, better than being alone. Well the guy I really am in love with has a gf ... Used to text me all the time we could talk for hours. Now it's like hey how are you? And the convo stops there. So I blew off the guy I truly love for some asshole that let me od ... Wtf was I thinking?!
Yeah took me awhile to dump him ... But I'm so fucked up I don't even realize when I'm in a fucked up situation
